sections.heading: What is trending: “weather tomorrow”
paragraphs: “weather tomorrow” appeared on Google Trends' Trending Now list for SG (snapshot taken 2026-08-17T13:52:59+00:00 UTC). Google reports at least 5,000 searches for this term — that figure is a lower bound published in the official Trends feed, not an exact count.

sections.heading: What's behind the spike — the coverage
paragraphs: The Trends feed associates this search spike with 3 news stories from Business Standard, Business Today, The Economic Times. The headlines, exactly as published:
list: “Weather Tomorrow August 17: IMD predicts rain, thunderstorms and heavy showers across several states; chec” — The Economic Times
“Monsoon update: IMD issues heavy rainfall alert across India from August 16. Check state-wise forecast” — Business Today
“Delhi likely to get light rain; monsoon remains active across India” — Business Standard

sections.heading: Timeline
paragraphs: The trend entry was published to the Google Trends feed at Mon, 17 Aug 2026 06:00:00 -0700. Our snapshot was taken at 2026-08-17T13:52:59+00:00 UTC and this briefing was assembled at 2026-08-17T13:53:52+00:00 UTC.

sections.heading: How to read these numbers
paragraphs: Google Trends reports approximate search volume as a lower bound (for example “20K+”). Actual volume can be significantly higher. Trending status reflects acceleration in searches, not the absolute size of a topic. For the full story behind the spike, read the cited coverage below — this briefing intentionally adds no speculation beyond the sourced facts.
